contract: CameraX1.6.2 front-camera preview/photo capture with bundled ML Kit face-detection16.1.7. Requires an Activity/lifecycle host; manifest declares CAMERA with optional camera hardware. Runtime request happens only on Allow camera; denied state opens Android app settings. Pass an account/request-scoped contextKey,isActive,onBack and onContinue. Continue returns true only after host takes ownership of the private-cache photo; false retains it for retry. Retake/back/disposal discard unaccepted task-owned photos; stale callbacks delete only their own new file. Own use cases unbind on inactive/non-RESUMED/disposal without unbindAll. Detection throttles100ms,keeps latest frame and always closes ImageProxy; crop rectangles rotate into detector coordinates. Live and saved JPEG require one face,source2.8%-82% area bounds,native central15%-85% bounds and within18degrees yaw/pitch. Captured image is independently checked,including source RGB luminance0.08; live Y luminance is an approximation,not ARKit lux. Observations older750ms cannot trigger capture. Original96point superellipse1.36aspect and green/gray tick treatment adapted. Screen light changes only Activity brightness and restores it. No microphone,upload or wellness score. This is a 2D photo capture adaptation,NOT equivalent ARKit3D scanning: mesh/depth,visited-sector scanning,head-tilt/arrival phases,video/gallery import,matched zoom/exact rings/haptics and full analyzer integrations remain unfinished. CameraX/ML Kit hardware behavior,EXIF/mirroring,crop,flash,permission lifecycle and pixel/motion parity require physical Android testing; host tests cover UI/model only. No actual photo was captured during development validation.
visual: host UI/model only; actual hardware unverified
remaining: ARKit3D mesh/depth,visited-sector scanning,head-tilt/video/gallery import and full analysis are not implemented
Exact camera transitions,rings,fonts and physical/iOS comparison
